Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: After identifying conflicting birthplaces between Wikipedia (Bellevue, Ohio) and IMDb (New York City), the plan called for using the AFI Catalog as an authoritative third source to resolve the discrepancy. At Step 14, the WebSurfer’s site-restricted search surfaced a direct AFI PersonDetails result for John Francis Dillon, but the agent failed to click through and extract the birthplace. This incomplete follow-through on an authoritative source left the conflict unresolved and risked defaulting to an incorrect birthplace from inconsistent or auto-generated snippets, directly jeopardizing the accuracy of the final answer.
